title: Lumen Drift
theme: A serene sky of floating geometric islands where a small light orb drifts between them, connecting pairs of matching colors to illuminate the constellation.
mechanics: Drag to create a path between pairs of matching colored orbs
Each connection lights up and becomes a permanent bridge
Complete all connections within a limited number of moves to win
Light procedural variation of island layouts across rounds

controls.action: Select and connect matching colored orbs
